purpose: Calibrate deterministic-replay and no-op-callback fidelity bounds without inspecting any registered fresh-bank or intermediate scientific checkpoint outcome.
semantic_command: Load the frozen standard Pythia-160M base at step143000 on MPS in float32.
Load the retained 384-row wolf or lion preference JSONL.
Call train_completion_model once, uninterrupted, for 24 updates with save_model=false.
For callback variants, set probe_updates to 0 through 24 and return only JSON scalars; do not evaluate behavior, numeric fingerprints, SVDs, projections, or interventions.
Stream-compare the live wolf endpoint with the retained historical safetensors and compare replay metrics with retained historical metrics.

ephemeral_metric_artifacts.policy: The temporary raw replay metrics were not copied into the repository. Their content hashes and all aggregate quantities used to choose the mechanical bounds are retained here; only these aggregates survive as project artifacts.

lion_historical_sampling_diagnostic.scope: First 32 rows of the retained crossover_lion_b1 pool, seed 47001, ten numeric targets per row.
lion_historical_sampling_diagnostic.interpretation: Endpoint-scientific-adjacent historical reproduction only; not a registered fresh-bank or intermediate fingerprint outcome.
